source: src_vs_code/package.json at P (9f62e4db): compile = `tsc -p ./`, typecheck = `tsc -p ./ --noEmit`, lint = `eslint src`, test = `npm run compile && node --test "out/test/*.test.js"`, ratchet = `npm run compile && node scripts/size-ratchet.mjs`. tsconfig: rootDir src, outDir out, so src/test/X.test.ts -> out/test/X.test.js. Lockfile pins typescript 5.9.3, eslint 10.11.0. Local node v24.18.0 (node --test expands the glob itself, no shell needed).
notes: tsc emits even when it reports errors (no noEmitOnError in tsconfig), exit code 2. After materialising a hold-out .ts, record compile's exit code and diagnostics SEPARATELY from the test run: a non-zero compile caused by the hold-out file (e.g. TS2339 'bundleKey' does not exist) is itself the hold-out failing; an emitted .js may still run.
A stale out/ can hide a missing compile: delete out/test/<name>.test.js before compiling a materialised hold-out, and fail the run if it was not re-emitted.

The compile-fail harness (out/test/typedFixtures.test.js) resolves its fixtures from the package root at run time, so testAll needs the candidate's own src fixtures present — it is the candidate's harness, never S's.
